title: Making, Changing, and Confirming Appointments
summary: Scheduling meetings and reacting when plans change.
whyItMatters: A successful appointment exchange must identify the purpose, compare available times, respond to changes, and repeat the final agreement. These phrases work for medical, service, work, and personal appointments.

mentalModel.title: Purpose, options, agreement
mentalModel.content: Start by naming why you need the appointment, compare specific options, and finish with one agreed slot.

mentalModel.title: A change needs a replacement
mentalModel.content: When cancelling or moving an appointment, state the problem and immediately ask for or propose another time.

mentalModel.title: Confirmation is a read-back
mentalModel.content: Repeat the day, date, time, place, and any preparation so both sides hold the same plan.

ruleBlocks.title: State the appointment purpose
ruleBlocks.content: Use 'Ich möchte einen Termin für ... vereinbaren' or 'Ich brauche einen Termin bei ...'.

ruleBlocks.title: Offer concrete options
ruleBlocks.content: Ask about a day or present two alternatives: 'Geht Dienstagvormittag oder Mittwoch um drei?'

ruleBlocks.title: Explain and repair a change
ruleBlocks.content: Use 'Ich muss den Termin leider verschieben/absagen' and request a new appointment.

ruleBlocks.title: Read back the final agreement
ruleBlocks.content: Confirm with 'Also am ... um ... bei ...' and ask whether anything must be brought.

tables.title: Conversation Toolkit
rows: Haben Sie am Dienstag etwas frei?
Wie wäre es am Mittwoch um 15 Uhr?
Ich muss den Termin leider absagen.

tables.title: Reacting to Changes
rows: Da kann ich leider nicht. Haben Sie später etwas frei?
Wäre ein Termin am Vormittag möglich?
Können Sie mir den Termin per E-Mail bestätigen?

sentenceStructure: Open with purpose and desired service.
Use exact date and time expressions.
Add an alternative when rejecting a proposal.

concepts: manage cancellations, policies, and complex arrangements

comparisons.summary: The theme lesson supplies calendar, message, and schedule-change vocabulary.
The grammar lesson distinguishes intended actions from what will happen next.

examples.de: A: Ich möchte einen Termin bei Frau Dr. Klein vereinbaren. B: Passt Ihnen Dienstag um neun?
examples.en: A: I would like to arrange an appointment with Dr. Klein. B: Does Tuesday at nine suit you?

examples.de: A: Am Dienstag kann ich leider nicht. Haben Sie am Mittwoch etwas frei?
examples.en: A: Unfortunately I cannot on Tuesday. Do you have anything available on Wednesday?

examples.de: A: Ich muss meinen Termin verschieben. B: Wann können Sie kommen?
examples.en: A: I have to reschedule my appointment. B: When can you come?

examples.de: A: Also Donnerstag, den 18., um 14 Uhr. B: Genau.
examples.en: A: So Thursday the 18th at 2 p.m. B: Exactly.

examples.de: Können Sie mir den neuen Termin bitte per E-Mail bestätigen?
examples.en: Can you please confirm the new appointment by email?

commonMistakes.wrong: Ich brauche einen Termin irgendwann nächste Woche.
commonMistakes.correct: Haben Sie am Dienstag- oder Mittwochvormittag etwas frei?
Ich muss den Termin leider absagen. Können wir einen neuen Termin vereinbaren?
commonMistakes.reason: Name the appointment change and request the next step.

commonMistakes.correct: Repeat the date and time before closing.

specialCases: 'Den' before a date is common in formal confirmation: 'Dienstag, den 12. Mai'.
'Etwas frei haben' means having an available appointment slot.
Use 'bei' for an appointment with a professional or at a practice.
tips: Keep a blank calendar visible during role-play.
Practice one original appointment and two changes.
Always finish with a spoken or written confirmation.
